findings.description: Dead branch: 'no_device' in ErrorKind type is never assigned. setErrorKind is only ever called with 'webview', so lines 338-345 are unreachable in practice.
findings.detail: ErrorKind type allows 'webview' | 'no_device'. errorKind defaults to 'webview'. All setErrorKind calls pass 'webview'. The JSX block at line 338 (errorKind === 'no_device') can never render. The setErrorKind('no_device') assignment was likely removed during refactoring but the branch was left.
findings.recommendation: Remove the 'no_device' variant from ErrorKind type and delete the dead JSX block (lines 338-345).

findings.description: Unused component: AnimatedButton and AnimatedIconButton are never imported by any screen or parent component.
findings.detail: Both exports are defined with full gesture/haptic support but have zero consumers. grep 'AnimatedButton' across app/ and components/ returns only the definition file itself.
findings.recommendation: Delete AnimatedButton.tsx. If needed later, it's in git history.

findings.description: Unused component: BatteryLevel is never imported by any screen.
findings.detail: Defined with full styles and battery visualization logic. No consumer in the app. The dashboard shows food level via CircularProgress, not battery.

findings.description: Unused component: CustomSlider is never imported, while controls.tsx has its own inline PctSlider that duplicates horizontal slider logic.
findings.detail: CustomSlider uses react-native-gesture-handler + reanimated for a horizontal slider. The only place a horizontal slider is needed (controls.tsx) reimplements the same thing as a local PctSlider function with TouchableOpacity. The implementation effort was duplicated.
findings.recommendation: Either replace the inline PctSlider in controls.tsx with CustomSlider, or delete CustomSlider.tsx. Keep one source of truth.

findings.description: Unused component: DistanceSensor is never imported by any screen.
findings.detail: Has minDistance/maxDistance props, status icons, and a visual bar indicator. Dashboard renders food level and distance inline via its own JSX rather than using this component.

findings.description: Unused component: ErrorToast is never imported by any screen or parent.
findings.detail: Animated toast with timed auto-dismiss. No screen uses it. The app uses InlineError and ConnectionBadge instead.

findings.description: Unused component: PaddleControl is never imported by any screen.
findings.detail: Wraps VerticalSlider with a themed container. No consumer. This also means VerticalSlider.tsx is only reachable through PaddleControl — making it transitively dead code.
findings.recommendation: Delete PaddleControl.tsx and, if no other consumer exists, VerticalSlider.tsx.

findings.description: Unused component: TabButton is never imported by any screen.
findings.detail: A segmented-control style tab button. The log tabs in history.tsx use inline TouchableOpacity styling instead of this component.

findings.description: Unused component: ExternalLink is never imported by any app screen.
findings.detail: Utility component for rendering external links with expo-linking. Zero consumers in app/. Only +not-found.tsx references ThemedText/ThemedView but not ExternalLink.

findings.description: Cloud-residue naming: style classes cloudInfoContainer, cloudTitle, cloudSubtitle, cloudIconContainer are used for local WiFi / direct-AP connection UI that has no cloud dependency.
findings.detail: These four style names appear 17 times across the file in the no-device-configured and feeder-not-found sections. They suggest the UI was originally built for a cloud-broker discovery model that was later replaced by local MQTT/mDNS. The 'cloud' prefix is misleading — these are purely local-connection views.
findings.recommendation: Rename to statusInfoContainer, statusTitle, statusSubtitle, statusIconContainer (or similar local-meaning names).

findings.description: File named InlineError but its primary consumed export is ConnectionBadge. The InlineError component itself is unused.
findings.detail: InlineError.tsx exports two components: InlineError (unused) and ConnectionBadge (used in dashboard). A maintainer looking for ConnectionBadge wouldn't guess it lives in InlineError.tsx. The file name describes the wrong export.
findings.recommendation: Rename file to ConnectionBadge.tsx and extract/delete InlineError, or split into separate files.

findings.description: Wrong icon: 'house.fill' (home icon) used for the Sensor Logs header. house.fill is the dashboard tab icon.
findings.detail: Tab layout uses house.fill for the Dashboard tab. Using the same icon on the Logs/History page for its page header creates visual confusion — it looks like the user is on the dashboard.
findings.recommendation: Replace 'house.fill' with 'doc.text', 'list.bullet', 'chart.bar.fill', or another document/logs-appropriate icon.

findings.description: SENSOR_RANGES in useAlerts.ts duplicates validation ranges hardcoded as inline functions in DashboardScreen.
findings.detail: useAlerts.ts defines SENSOR_RANGES = { TEMPERATURE: { min: -40, max: 85 }, FOOD_LEVEL: { min: 0, max: 100 }, DISTANCE: { min: 0, max: 400 } }. DashboardScreen duplicates these as three isValid* functions: isValidTemperature(-40..85), isValidFoodLevel(0..100), isValidDistance(0..400). If ranges change, both must be updated in sync.
findings.recommendation: Export SENSOR_RANGES (or validation helpers) from useAlerts.ts or a shared constants file, and consume them in DashboardScreen.

findings.description: Uses relative imports ('../hooks/...', './ui/...') while all other screens use '@/' path aliases.
findings.detail: ESP32Connection.tsx imports from '../hooks/useESP32Context' and './ui/IconSymbol' instead of '@/hooks/useESP32Context' and '@/components/ui/IconSymbol'. This is inconsistent and breaks if the component is moved to a different depth.
findings.recommendation: Replace relative imports with @/ aliases for consistency.

residual_risks.description: useMountEffect is a one-line wrapper around useEffect(() => fn, []) that adds an abstraction layer without behavioral change. All 3 usages (SplashHider, useStoredChipId) could use useEffect directly. The wrapper costs a function boundary and module import for no gain.
residual_risks.recommendation: Inline useEffect calls directly. Delete useMountEffect.ts.

residual_risks.description: useAlerts hook is tightly coupled to useESP32Context. It directly accesses deviceData and isConnected from a global context. Any change to the shape of ESP32Data or the context API forces changes here. The hook also silently assumes the ESP32 provider exists above it in the tree.
residual_risks.recommendation: Consider making deviceData a parameter rather than reaching into context directly, to decouple alert generation from connection state.

residual_risks.description: PctSlider in controls.tsx is an inline component that duplicates the functionality of CustomSlider.tsx. 18 lines of slider logic living inside the screen file rather than in a shared component. If sliders need consistent visual updates, both would need parallel changes.
residual_risks.recommendation: Replace inline PctSlider with a refactored CustomSlider, or extract PctSlider to its own file.

testing_gaps.description: 9 out of 18 UI components in components/ui/ are unreferenced dead code. These have no tests and can't be tested since nothing exercises them. They add cognitive load during test writing — a future developer must first figure out which components are actually wired in.
testing_gaps.recommendation: Delete all unused components, then write tests for the remaining ~10 UI components. Without deletion first, test coverage targets on 'all components' are misleading — 47% of components have zero real-world usage.
